attributes.name: Thriae Dancer
attributes.powers:
Thriae Dancer is immune to the Poison trait. All damage dealt by Thriae Dancer is Poison damage.

If each character at your location reveals the henchman Stolen Larvae, you may evade Thriae Dancer.

If defeated, you may examine the top card of any location deck.
